response.sql: WITH per_name AS (SELECT e.event_name AS event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS avg_amt FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.event_name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amt) AS overall_avg FROM per_name), kept AS (SELECT p.event_name, p.avg_amt FROM per_name p, overall o WHERE p.avg_amt > o.overall_avg), kept_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amt) AS kept_avg FROM kept) SELECT k.event_name, k.avg_amt AS average_amount, k.avg_amt - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall, k.avg_amt / ka.kept_avg AS ratio_to_kept_avg FROM kept k, overall o, kept_avg ka
